mapper.select: select consultant_id from app_consultant where user_id = #{userId} and status = '01' limit 1

select concat('customer:', c.customer_id) sourceRecordId, 'eldercare' businessLine, c.customer_no code, c.customer_name name, c.customer_label status, c.acquisition_channel sourceChannel, c.customer_goods preference, c.return_visit_remark followUpNote, null orderCount, null totalSpend, date_format(coalesce(c.update_time, c.create_time), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') sourceUpdatedAt, case when c.return_visit is null then null when c.return_visit = 1 then true else false end followUpRequired from app_customer c where c.del_flag = '0' and (#{admin} = true or (#{consultantId} is not null and c.consultant_id = #{consultantId})) order by coalesce(c.update_time, c.create_time) desc, c.customer_id desc limit 1000

select concat('order:', o.order_id) sourceRecordId, case when g.goods_type in ('hotel', 'travel') then 'travel' else 'eldercare' end businessLine, coalesce(o.feishu_order_no, o.order_no) code, o.contact_name customerName, coalesce(o.travel_base_name, g.goods_name) productName, case o.travel_status when '0' then '待确认' when '1' then '已确认' when '2' then '已取消' when '3' then '已入住' when '4' then '已离店' when '5' then '已结算' when '6' then '退款中' when '7' then '已退款' else o.status end status, o.channel channel, coalesce(o.pay_money, o.money_payable) amount, date_format(o.check_in_date, '%Y-%m-%d') checkInDate, date_format(o.check_out_date, '%Y-%m-%d') checkOutDate from app_goods_order o left join app_goods g on g.goods_id = o.goods_id where #{admin} = true or exists ( select 1 from app_user_inviter i where i.user_id = #{actorUserId} and i.new_user_id = o.user_id and i.status = '1' ) order by o.order_id desc limit 1000

select concat('order:', o.order_id) collate utf8mb4_general_ci sourceRecordId, 'travel' collate utf8mb4_general_ci businessLine, coalesce(o.feishu_order_no, o.order_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci code, o.contact_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci customerName, coalesce(o.travel_base_name, g.goods_name) collate utf8mb4_general_ci productName, case o.travel_status when '0' then '待确认' when '1' then '已确认' when '2' then '已取消' when '3' then '已入住' when '4' then '已离店' when '5' then '已结算' when '6' then '退款中' when '7' then '已退款' else o.status end collate utf8mb4_general_ci status, o.channel collate utf8mb4_general_ci channel, case when o.is_cash is null then null when o.is_cash = 1 then true else false end settled, coalesce(o.pay_money, o.money_payable) amount, null profit, date_format(o.check_in_date, '%Y-%m-%d') collate utf8mb4_general_ci checkInDate, date_format(o.check_out_date, '%Y-%m-%d') collate utf8mb4_general_ci checkOutDate from app_goods_order o left join app_goods g on g.goods_id = o.goods_id where (g.goods_type in ('hotel', 'travel') or o.travel_status is not null) and (#{admin} = true or exists ( select 1 from app_user_inviter i where i.user_id = #{actorUserId} and i.new_user_id = o.user_id and i.status = '1' )) union all select concat('income:', i.income_id) collate utf8mb4_general_ci sourceRecordId, 'eldercare' collate utf8mb4_general_ci businessLine, i.income_no collate utf8mb4_general_ci code, null customerName, i.product_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci productName, case when i.settlement = 1 then '已结算' else '待结算' end collate utf8mb4_general_ci status, null channel, case when i.settlement is null then null when i.settlement = 1 then true else false end settled, i.purchase_amount amount, case when #{admin} = true then i.company_income else i.consultant_income end profit, date_format(i.trade_date, '%Y-%m-%d') collate utf8mb4_general_ci checkInDate, null checkOutDate from app_customer_income i where #{admin} = true or (#{consultantId} is not null and i.consultant_id = #{consultantId}) order by sourceRecordId desc
select distinct customer_label from app_customer where customer_label is not null and customer_label != '' and del_flag = '0' order by customer_label
mapper.update:
update app_customer
customer_label = #{status}, customer_goods = #{preference}, return_visit_remark = #{followUpNote}, update_time = now()
where customer_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and (#{admin} = true or (#{consultantId} is not null and consultant_id = #{consultantId})) and coalesce(customer_label, '') = coalesce(#{expectedStatus}, '')

update app_goods_order set travel_status = #{status}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{id} and coalesce(travel_status, '') = coalesce(#{expectedStatus}, '') and (#{admin} = true or exists ( select 1 from app_user_inviter i where i.user_id = #{actorUserId} and i.new_user_id = app_goods_order.user_id and i.status = '1' ))

update app_goods_order set is_cash = #{settled}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{id} and coalesce(is_cash, -1) = coalesce(#{expected}, -1) and (#{admin} = true or exists ( select 1 from app_user_inviter i where i.user_id = #{actorUserId} and i.new_user_id = app_goods_order.user_id and i.status = '1' ))

update app_customer_income set settlement = #{settled}, update_time = now() where income_id = #{id} and coalesce(settlement, -1) = coalesce(#{expected}, -1) and (#{admin} = true or (#{consultantId} is not null and consultant_id = #{consultantId}))
